results.heading: 01 POSITION
results.text:
01 POSITION
You are offered the role of Data Analyst reporting to the Head of Analytics.

results.heading: 02 SERVICE COMMITMENT
results.text:
02 SERVICE COMMITMENT
You shall serve the Company for a minimum period of three (3) years from the date of joining. In the event you resign before completing this period, you shall pay the Company a sum of Rs. 5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakh only) as liquidated damages, recoverable as a debt.

findings.message: A minimum service commitment backed by money. Section 74 allows only reasonable compensation for breach, whatever figure the contract names.
findings.citation_span: 74. results.heading: 03 NOTICE PERIOD
results.text:
03 NOTICE PERIOD
The Employee shall give ninety (90) days written notice of resignation. The Company may terminate this employment on thirty (30) days notice.

findings.message: Notice is unequal between the two sides.

results.heading: 04 CONFIDENTIALITY
results.text:
04 CONFIDENTIALITY
You shall keep confidential all information relating to the Company in perpetuity, whether or not such information is or becomes publicly available.

results.heading: 05 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
results.text:
05 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All inventions, discoveries, improvements and works of authorship conceived or created by you during the term of your employment, whether during or outside the usual hours of work and whether on or off the premises of the Company, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company. You hereby irrevocably assign to the Company all right, title and interest therein, including all moral rights.

findings.message: Assigns work created outside working hours or off premises. Anything you build on your own time may vest with the employer.
findings.citation_span: 19. (3) The assignment of copyright in any work shall also specify the amount of 3[royalty and any other consideration payable], to the author or his legal heirs during the currency of the assignment and the assignment shall be subject to revision, extension or termination on terms mutually agreed upon by the parties. findings.message: Broad IP assignment with no carve-out for work you already owned. Many letters list excluded prior projects, and asking for one is reasonable.
Purports to assign moral rights. Section 57 keeps moral rights with the author regardless of what the contract says.

results.heading: 06 NON-COMPETITION
results.text:
06 NON-COMPETITION
For a period of twenty-four (24) months following the termination of your employment for any reason whatsoever, you shall not directly or indirectly engage in, or be employed by, any business that competes with the Company anywhere in India.

findings.message: Post-termination restraint on where you may work. Section 27 voids agreements in restraint of trade to that extent.
findings.note: Indian courts do not weigh duration or geography the way US and UK courts do, so a short restraint is not meaningfully safer than a long one. The narrow exception is a covenant that only protects confidential information.
findings.citation_span: 27. Agreement in restraint of trade, void.—Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void. Exception 1.—Saving of agreement not to carry on business of which good-will is sold.—One who sells the good-will of a business may agree with the buyer to refrain from carrying on a similar business, within specified local limits, so long as the buyer, or any person deriving title to the good-will from him, carries on a like business therein, provided that such limits appear to the Court reasonable, regard being had to the nature of the business. 1* * * * *.

results.heading: 07 TERMINATION
results.text:
07 TERMINATION
The Company may terminate your employment at any time with immediate effect for any act or omission which in the sole opinion of the Company is detrimental to the best interests of the Company.

evidence: TERMINATION The Company may terminate your employment at any time with immediate effect
findings.message: Cause is defined broadly enough to cover ordinary performance, with no closed list and no cure period.

results.heading: 08 GOVERNING LAW
results.text:
08 GOVERNING LAW
Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration before a sole arbitrator appointed by the Company, seated in the city of the Company's registered office.

findings.message: One side alone appoints the arbitrator.

audit.disclaimer: Flags for review, not legal advice.

draft.draft:
I am reviewing the draft agreement and need the following clauses amended.

The minimum service commitment and liquidated‑damages clause must be removed. Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 speaks directly to this.

The notice periods must be equalised; replace “ninety (90) days written notice of resignation” and “thirty (30) days notice” with a single notice period of thirty (30) days for both parties.

The assignment of work created outside working hours or off premises must be deleted. Section 19 of the Copyright Act, 1957 speaks directly to this.

The broad IP assignment must include a carve‑out for any inventions, discoveries, improvements or works of authorship that I owned or created prior to joining the Company. Please add a schedule of excluded prior projects.

The clause purporting to assign moral rights must be removed. Section 57 of the Copyright Act, 1957 speaks directly to this.

The post‑termination non‑compete must be limited to a maximum of six (6) months and confined to the geographic area where I actually performed duties. Section 27 voids agreements in restraint of trade to that extent.

The termination for cause provision must be revised to list specific grounds and provide a reasonable cure period before termination takes effect.

The arbitration clause must be changed so that the arbitrator is appointed jointly by both parties, rather than solely by the Company.
